**Author**: Erik Broekhuizen

**Coverage**: Full PDF archived locally under reports/poten/pdfs/2016/Weekly-Opinion-April-15-2016-Tanker-Income-Inequality.pdf. Analysis & Overview
Tanker Income Inequality
15 April 2016: Typically, the Suezmax and VLCC markets behave somewhat similarly over a period of time. However, in Q1 of 2016 we have experienced a significant divergence in rates between the two segments.
